generator.family: Unchanged v1 rotational generator with seed arguments
generator.person_pairing: identical centered offsets/opposite phases; preserve whole adjacent pairs

realizations.purpose: training/development selection, then one held-out evaluation
independent generated realization at fixed selected rho

ensemble: mean probabilities; no favorable seed selection

selection.eligibility: All four predictive gates pass on development
selection.criterion: maximum positive expected-NLL gain among eligible candidates
selection.none_eligible: NO_QUALIFIED_INTERACTION; no holdout scoring and no realization B
selection.freeze_before: A held-out scoring and B materialization
selection.support_condition: informative only; no uninformative development adaptation batches

overall_qualification: Complete valid audit records AND passed numerical checks AND saved-array verification AND development eligibility AND all four predictive gates separately on held-out A and B

holdout_rule.B: one evaluation at same selected configuration; new training on B's training block
holdout_rule.overall_predictive_qualification: all four predictive gates pass separately on both A and B

certificate.training_intercepts: one batch per regime and realization, lambda_b=.1
certificate.role: explanatory training-only diagnostic; cannot replace predictive gates
certificate.B: one intercept batch per regime, two total, evaluate selected rho only

checkpoint_order: scientific code and complete design pushed and posted
selected rho, model hashes and conditional later-stage ledgers pushed and posted
implementation_notes: Exact stage IDs must be bound before their stage runs
No optimizer needed for finite-difference/objective/rescaling checks
Unused budget does not authorize additional scientific fits
Complete all predeclared B work after A held-out scientific failure unless execution is invalid or resource-limited; B cannot rescue A
interpretation_limits: Synthetic informative numerical features, not a text-embedding test
96 supports in two dimensions; no conclusion at DICES 16/384
Two realizations do not establish universal null behavior or human-domain generalization
